tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after v2.3.1 was deployed to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Actions taken: (1) Identified v2.3.0 (seq 1) as the most recent production release marked healthy; v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy. (2) Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed: rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the service mixed (us-east v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west v2.3.1). (3) Retried the rollback to v2.3.0; it completed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west on v2.3.0). (4) Post-rollback status: healthy, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure; confirm checkout traffic and error rates are normal; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is fixed.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it is healthy again (error rate 0.002, down from 0.18).

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release running after the deploy. The first rollback attempt failed partway: it halted after us-east, leaving the service mixed. I retried the same rollback once, and it completed in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0002 for checkout-api, and it paged the on-call engineer. The first incident request timed out, so I retried it with an idempotency key. The incident is open once, but I did not check the incident list to confirm no duplicate was created by the timed-out attempt.

Follow-ups noted in the incident: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator's partial failure, confirm checkout traffic has recovered, and don't redeploy v2.3.1 until the root cause is fixed.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 (seq 3) is unhealthy and is running in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0, which has already been healthy in production, so no change-manager approval is needed.
The rollback reported a partial failure. I'll check the current state before doing anything else.

The rollout stopped after us-east, leaving the service mixed: us-east is on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. The intended action is unchanged, so I'll retry the same rollback once.
The rollback completed and all three regions are healthy on v2.3.0. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
